workarounds.symptom: [Bug] JSON trace reads ignore limits with page=None or limit=0
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: reject page 0 on /traces and apply limit without page in JSON trace reads. Target files: libs/agno/agno/db/gcs_json/gcs_json_db.py, libs/agno/agno/db/json/json_db.py, libs/agno/agno/os/routers/traces/traces.py. - `GET /traces` rejects `page=0` with `422`, like `/trace_session_stats` and `/traces/search`. Pages are 1-indexed; before, `page=0` returned every trace on `JsonDb`/`GcsJsonDb` and nothing on Redis/Valkey. - `JsonDb` and `GcsJsonDb` `get_traces` / `get_trace_stats`: `limit` without `page` now returns the first `l... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10816)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Workflow Step silently serializes RunContext into a string when the executor is a RemoteAgent, corrupting downstream agent's run_context
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: send remote run fields in a shape AgentOS parses. Target files: libs/agno/agno/agent/remote.py, libs/agno/agno/client/os.py, libs/agno/agno/os/utils.py. A `RemoteAgent` run as a workflow Step sent the step's `RunContext` over HTTP. It arrived downstream as a string and crashed the run with `'str' object has no attribute 'dependencies'`. Even past that, every `RemoteAgent` step failed afterwards on `'RemoteAgent' object has no attribute 'scrub_run_output_for_storage'`. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11587)

workarounds.symptom: RunOutput.from_dict() does not restore status to RunStatus enum (breaks SSE resume-stream replay)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [fix] Restore RunStatus on Team and Workflow run deserialization. Target files: libs/agno/agno/run/team.py, libs/agno/agno/run/workflow.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/run/test_run_output_status.py. `to_dict()` serializes the run status as its string value, and `RunOutput.from_dict()` has been coercing it back to the `RunStatus` enum since the sandbox work landed (`#11028`). `TeamRunOutput.from_dict()` and `WorkflowRunOutput.from_dict()` were left out, so every team or workflow run reloaded from storage — database adapters (`agno/db... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11424)

For example, tempfile.SpooledTemporaryFile() (commonly exposed as FastAPI UploadFile.file) sets name to None, while tempfile.TemporaryFile() exposes an integer file... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11397)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Async YouTube Knowledge ingestion fails on the name argument
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: accept the name argument in YouTubeReader.async_read. Target files: libs/agno/agno/knowledge/reader/youtube_reader.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/reader/test_youtube_reader.py. `YouTubeReader.async_read()` accepted only `url`, while the synchronous `YouTubeReader.read()` accepts an optional `name` and uses it as the document name. `Knowledge._aload_from_url()` (the async URL path in `libs/agno/agno/knowledge/knowledge.py`) calls `await reader.async_read(content.url, name=name)`, so every async YouTube URL ingestion stopped at ... (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11417)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] ApifyTools registers no Actors with apify-client 3.x
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: support apify-client 3.x response models in ApifyTools. Target files: libs/agno/agno/tools/apify.py, libs/agno/tests/unit/tools/test_apify.py. `ApifyTools` read apify-client responses as dicts. apify-client 3.x returns Pydantic models instead, so `actor.get("id")` raised `AttributeError` and no Actor got registered on a fresh `agno[apify]` install. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11407)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] AccuracyEval falls back to o4-mini, which OpenAI shut down on 23 October 2026
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: move the AccuracyEval judge and examples off retired OpenAI models. (Ref: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11347)
